snippets.title: Summing a list with a loop
snippets.code:
numbers = [3, 1, 4]
total = 0
for n in numbers:
    total = total + n
print(total)

snippets.title: Calling a function
snippets.code:
def square(x):
    result = x * x
    return result

value = square(4)
print(value)

snippets.title: While loop countdown
snippets.code:
count = 3
while count > 0:
    print(count)
    count -= 1
print('lift off')
